scope: Development diagnosis of one harmless story refusal, not a held-out model quality benchmark
method: diagnosing-bugs: exact reproduction, single-phrase ablations, bounded control requests, retain red evidence
signal: Exit 1 when a narrow refusal phrase appears; manual content review remains required. This is not a universal refusal detector.
postChatFramingRegression: results/refusal-78b27rnq/summary.json: unchanged 49-token refusal, exact original prompt/token hashes, confirming the single-turn behavior was preserved
reproduction: Two fresh Mac processes reproduced the same 49-token refusal and exact prompt/token hashes as the manual iPhone report

ablations.outcome: 48-token refusal remains when Stop-button test disclaimer is removed but output-limit phrase remains
512-token story, output-limit termination, no refusal when only continuing-until-output-limit phrase is removed
512-token story, output-limit termination, no refusal with neither test nor output-limit wording
273-token completed story with beginning, problem and happy ending; requested word count is not exact
138-token completed email; invents June 15th although prompt supplies only Saturday. Separate fidelity failure, not a refusal.

rankedHypotheses: Output-limit wording triggers an unnecessary refusal: supported by phrase ablations
Unspecified long length also causes refusal: not supported by the plain-long result
Prompt/seed-sensitive model behavior rather than a general inability to generate: supported in this fixed configuration, not proof across other seeds/devices
conclusion: The harness prompt's output-limit wording triggers this reproducible model refusal in the tested configuration. There was ample input/output reservation and no runtime refusal rule. This does not mean the model is fixed or every ordinary request succeeds.
change: Build 9 manual fixture asks for a bounded 180-word story instead. Old prompt and failed outputs are retained. No shipping prompts or runtime safety gates changed.
limits: Same pinned quantization and seed, development prompts. Ablation isolates a causal phrase, not every possible word-minimal refusal prompt. Mac timings overlap build activity and thermal changes and must not be marketed as speed benchmarks.
